client_name.description: The name of the client Nemura calls with.

client_public_key.description: The public half of the key Nemura's client signs its private_key_jwt assertions with, as a JWK: an EC P-256 key or an RSA key of 2048 bits or more. Never the private key.

expires_at.description: When the client stops, within a year (SEC-07); link again before then.

features.description: The features that live in Nemura from now on: Fyniq never loads them itself (FR-PPL-01).

items.description: A feature that can live in Nemura.

link_key.description: Nemura's Ed25519 public key for the link's envelopes, 32 bytes as base64url without padding: shown on Nemura's link page. Every event is checked against it.

nemura_ask_client_id.description: The ID Fyniq's read-only client, which asks whether a person is held at the release of a payment, will have at Nemura's OAuth server, as Nemura chose it when it proposed the link: shown on Nemura's link page.

nemura_client_id.description: The ID Fyniq's own client will have at Nemura's OAuth server, as Nemura chose it when it proposed the link: shown on Nemura's link page. Fyniq signs in to Nemura as this client to send its events.

nemura_organisation_id.description: The Nemura organisation to link to.

nemura_origin.description: Where Nemura's web app is served from, such as https://people.example.com: a passkey assertion made there names it, and Fyniq checks a pay run's approval against it (one relying-party ID, two origins).
